_comment: The CABIN's storage at the start (ship homes increment 6, data/homes/starts.ron `storage`), the same shape as data/places/seed.json: top-level entries are ENTITIES, each a container of rooms, sub-containers and items. A cabin holds little: the backpack you carry, and a locker in the cabin with spare clothes, a towel and a toiletry kit, as labels (free-text items, not in items.csv). Meals come from the mess hall and water from the ship, so there is no pantry.
